runnerPolicy.note: Runner facts are recorded in artifact evidence; the protocol does not require self-hosted runners.

versionImpact.rationale: Buildchain v2.8 promotes KFD self-verification, KFD-2 release trust passport audits, KFD-3 collaboration-interface trust proofs, publish source-lock enforcement, and GitHub Checks protected-channel governance as a minor runtime line.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Adds KFD-1 self contract verification with source/artifact hashes, schema IDs, self-hosting boundary, result, and responsibility state.
Adds public release claim auditing that fails unbound claims and downgrades prose-only claims.
Adds KFD-3 self-verification for docs, schemas, standards metadata, package exports, site-consumption contracts, witness hashes, audit boundary, residual risk, and responsibility state.
Forces release-candidate promote wrappers to pass publish-gate source-lock inputs into promote-buildchain-ref before publish side effects.
Repairs managed protected channel branches to require GitHub Actions check runs instead of legacy commit status contexts.

recovery.rollback: Use the previous exact release tag or previous floating channel ref.
